prose: Fortune profiles Palo Alto Networks CEO Nikesh Arora, who is credited with growing revenue from $2.27 billion in fiscal 2018 to $11.48 billion in fiscal 2026 as AI reshapes cybersecurity. Fortune describes him as the person Fortune 500 and tech CEOs call when AI gets scary. Based on the Techmeme excerpt; the article was not retrieved.
highlights: Seen as the go-to for CEOs worried about AI
Profile of how AI reshapes cybersecurity
